name: @forguncy-react-workspace/runtime
//: `src/` imports `@forguncy-react-workspace/core/browser`, never bare `core`. That is not a
style choice: bare `core` re-exports `cell-registry` and `config-loader`, which read the
project off disk, so importing any name from it evaluates `node:fs`/`node:path`/`node:crypto`
at module scope. This package is the façade that Cell source calls (#27), so it has to be
loadable in a browser and flattenable into a Cell artifact — and with the bare import it was
neither: Vite's browser-external stub threw during module init, and `compileCell` refused the
A reviewer tempted to collapse the two back into one should read `core`'s `src/browser.ts`
first: `browser.test.ts` asserts the projection's module list and its `node:`-free graph,
which is what keeps this claim from being a comment.
